name: sri-kannathal-homecare
description: Frontend React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS application for Sri Kannathal Home Care & Nursing Service

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
